title: Line dancing class with Natalie Boyle in Port Jefferson Station
summary: A weekly country line dancing class with Natalie Boyle at the American Legion hall in Port Jefferson Station. She teaches the dances Long Island country bands and DJs play, from basic to intermediate steps. All levels welcome.
cadence: Tuesdays (Monday instead in the week of the 2nd Tuesday)
priceNotes: Price not published. Ask at the class or through her website.
sourceName: Country Dancing with Natalie, Events page (week of October 5, 2026)
sourceRef: Tuesday and Monday entries for the American Legion, Port Jefferson Station
reviewNotes: Added by hand on 2026-10-06 (issue #41) from Natalie's Lessons and Events pages; nothing else confirms it (the post's own calendar is empty) and no price is published. In the week of the 2nd Tuesday the class moves to Monday at 7 PM, so the repeat rule has those Mondays as extra dates and the 2nd Tuesdays as removed dates, through January 2027, and ends January 31. Each month, check her Events page, add the next Monday swap and move UNTIL forward.
